race.comment: TARA'S REWARD (1) is the form runner, having won narrowly at Warwick before beating I AM A WINNER at this track, and the apprentice claim helps offset the big impost. I AM A WINNER (2) has twice gone under by narrow margins this campaign and has placed at both runs at this venue, so he remains a genuine threat despite again meeting TARA'S REWARD. IGOTMYMINDONYOU (3) finished fourth last time out over 860m at this track, beaten 3.5 lengths. Sure to be competitive. LADIES OCEAN RUN (7) resumes after six months with an easy Dalby trial win and blinkers for the first time. Well placed and in the mix.
